s00792.summary: On graduation night, six teens bargain with night manager Horace for more bowling time.
Cosmo catches Locky's tossed keys in a fry and regrets exactly one thing.
Beatrix asks about September plans; Phoebe admits she has none.
Phoebe rolls a last ball that wobbles in for a strike; the friends grin.

s01409.summary: Trainer Ignatius tapes Manuel's wrist in a steamy locker room as a stranger watches.
Tall man Ambrose introduces himself as the promoter's representative; Ignatius resists.
Ambrose says Manuel must go down in round three; both order him out.
Ignatius shuts the door and Manuel curls his gloved hands into fists.

s00533.summary: At a cattle auction, Hollis, estranged wife Maribel and rival Tavish sit in tense silence.
Tavish bids on the heifer; Hollis hesitates, then raises one finger.
Tavish nods and outbids; Maribel mutters eleven years and Hollis lowers his hand.

s00848.summary: Perpetua and Yoshiro offer tea to a silent stranger on the offshore platform.
Perpetua insists the stranger is their guest and gives her own bunk.
The stranger gives her name, Adebola, and says she swam to the platform.
Adebola explains she wanted to see if anyone lived there; Perpetua laughs and offers burnt toast.

s00639.summary: Tailor Bea pins a wedding dress while tense Soraya stares at herself in the mirror.
Soraya asks if Bea would stop her leaving through the back.
Bea silently unbuttons the dress and tells her the alley door sticks.

s00574.summary: Two soldiers in a cold relay hut ration wood and take a status call.
Medic Saari arrives from the storm after nine hours' walk, asking for tea.
Saari orders Nowak to remove his boot and finds white frostbitten toes.
Command announces a weather window; Barakzai looks at the young faces and says tomorrow.

s00725.summary: Attorney Sunita questions foreman Dmitri at an arbitration about a safety valve.
Dmitri admits he disengaged the valve and signed the log to pay for his nephew's hospital.
Conrad withdraws his motion and offers settlement; Helena adjourns.

s02132.summary: Attorney Ruth deposes anxious inspector Arjun in a ferry terminal and probes his crane certificate.
Arjun admits he inspected the wrong crane and blames his supervisor.

s00145.summary: Coach Eleanor scolds her late rowers and silently measures their nerve.
She finds a loose rigger and has Bashir fix it before ordering the boat out.

s00235.summary: Lieutenant Philippe reports a quiet night to Battalion but notices the candle too steady.
A boy slips in with tea from the other side and says they have been listening.
He tunes the radio to an enemy voice and gives his name, Alois; Philippe drinks.

s01554.summary: Ren slips into the pawn shop and says Gabe sent her to collect.
Ren demands eight thousand; Sol offers six and edges toward the lamp.
Sol rises and swings the lamp; they collide, and the lamp shatters in darkness.
Winded Sol offers the six; Ren lowers her hammer, takes the cash and leaves.

s01227.summary: An underground curling team banters before Padma throws a perfect stone on the button.
The referee measures; Kolya says that is the match.
June accuses Teddy of brushing the stone; the referee removes it from play.
Kolya mourns five years of Thursdays and walks away as the brooms fall.

s00245.summary: Isabella enters Master Zorzi's furnace room and says the Council sends regards.
She sets down a glass sample taken from his apprentice; Zorzi calls it stealing.
Zorzi grabs tongs; Isabella shows the glass bird and warns of the Council.
Zorzi smashes the bird, tells her to report ash; she pockets a shard.

s02426.summary: In a lunar laundromat, Gwen watches new hauler Rafi fumble with Euros.
Davenport's crossword clue draws answers from Gwen and Rafi.
Gwen hands Rafi a fallen sock and leaves the chair between them empty on purpose.

s01876.summary: Queen Sable stands before a humming bell in a drowned tower and demands it speak.
Her squire Dobrina climbs up, warning that the water is rising fast.
The bell cracks; they place their hands on it and a child's voice begins counting.

s01154.summary: Thorne, Moss and Briar wait in the oak grove for Aldyth to arrive.
Thorne points to a green sapling pushing up from the salted soil.
Aldyth steps into the ring, disbelieves the shoot, and learns it was planted before the burning.
Aldyth declares the oath broken and strides away as Briar shields the sapling.

s00524.summary: Inspector Oyelaran presses watchmaker Pell about his alibi among ticking clocks.
She spots the new mainspring and notes Hartigan's watch was found stopped at 8:52.
A phone call reveals his daughter Delphine put the watch in the canal.
Pell insists Hartigan fell after laughing at his wife's cuckoo, then slumps.
Pell surrenders the cellar key and the phone rings again.

s00247.summary: A multi-generational family bakes bread in a mountain village kitchen at dawn.
Inspector Elias arrives early through the snow, asking for the headmistress.
Zainab hands him warm bread first; he relaxes and the kettle sings.

s02450.summary: Farmer Ellsworth jokes with his dialysis staff about the long drive and diner pie.
An air-in-line alarm sounds; Moloi and Krzysztof scramble to clamp and flush.
The alarm stops; Ellsworth opens an eye and jokes with shaken staff.

s00503.summary: New hire Imogen offers donuts to grim Norbert, who doesn't look up.
Norbert tastes a donut, tears up at fourteen years without one, and she sits.

s00263.summary: A hiding courier points a pistol at Lady Georgiana as she climbs into the loft.
Georgiana charms and bluffs; he lowers his pistol and gives his name, Matthias.
Soldiers search; Georgiana pulls Matthias into the hay under her cloak.
Beneath the cloak they laugh with relief, and he says he owes her.

s01525.summary: Ferry officer Lindqvist presses a soaked man hiding in his car on the deck.
Deckhand Kofi spots blood on the man's boot as he steps out.
The man confesses his sister Annelie is dead in the terminal lockers.
Henrik gives his name and waits; Lindqvist orders a blanket as police arrive.

s01155.summary: Depot staff load an armored truck as a delivery man arrives with water jugs.
Winston triggers a hidden smoke latch, masks up, and the bay door slams shut.

s01277.summary: Kai complains at being summoned to a 3 a.m. laundromat, where Odalys folds towels.
Odalys admits his mother is moving to Portland and invites him to come.
She names his fear, jokes about her age, and says she came for the warmth.
Kai helps fold towels as Odalys calls folding a promise of warmth.
